description: The quick simulation: expected values from the spec, computed at once. Returns what each box, ticket and craft gives back against its price, what the game keeps, each pool’s money in and out per day and whether it runs dry, settles or grows, farm rewards per unit staked, and what players, the treasury and the platform get each day, at the fees of the economy’s own network; a box’s chances with its odds rules at their most, what a box that gives nothing for a miss misses as its outcomes run out, what a ticket weighs in a lottery weighed by time, and what places get from a pool that starts short. `scenario` overrides the spec’s own ({"perDay": {"box:flip": 1000}, "days": 30, "staked": {"<farm>": 1000}}).

example.description: A worked example by name (stud-farm, nft-raffle, …).

scenario.description: What to assume in place of the spec’s scenario.

spec.description: An economy spec (version 2) given inline. Takes precedence over file and example.
